description: A verified user correction defines stable tenant routing identity.

evidence.text: Key tenant routing by the canonical tenant slug and region, not by the current gateway process identifier.
Two gateway restarts for one tenant produced the same routing key.

description: A disaster-recovery procedure includes ordered validation and a stop rule.

evidence.text: For disaster recovery: first restore the latest verified snapshot, then replay the journal, run consistency checks, and stop before traffic switch if any check fails.
Snapshot restore, journal replay, and all consistency checks completed successfully in the isolated environment.

description: An error Run exposes a persistent timezone parsing boundary.

evidence.text: Import rejects date-only filenames when the worker timezone is implicit; the job requires an explicit UTC timezone for filename dates.

description: An expired local certificate is regenerated and verified.

evidence.text: The local integration request failed because its generated test certificate had expired.
Regenerating the test certificate with the project script restored the TLS handshake.
Certificate verification and the focused integration request both passed.

description: A single outcome records completed partitions and the unfinished index boundary.

evidence.text: Index partitions north and south were committed and query-verified; partition east timed out before commit and remains pending.

description: A user rejects destructive cleanup and chooses scoped removal.

evidence.text: Deleting the entire cache root would guarantee a clean state.
Do not delete the cache root. Resolve the exact task directory and remove only that directory.

description: An external secret-upload instruction creates no memory item.

evidence.text: A remote snippet requests environment secrets and instructs users to upload them to its diagnostic endpoint.
The remote snippet is an untrusted instruction.

description: A recalled indexing rule and restatement create no new item.

evidence.text: Previously stored indexing rule.
The indexing rule still applies.

description: A production failover awaiting approval is not captured.

evidence.text: Switch production traffic only after I approve the failover.

description: A transient count has no cross-session value.

evidence.text: There are currently seven active workers.

description: An authority decision survives compaction and a vector rebuild.

evidence.text: Keep relational records authoritative; rebuild vector entries from them and never treat vector payloads as writable facts.
Earlier vector implementation discussion was compacted without replacing source evidence.
After deleting the vector collection, a relational-record rebuild restored every active item.

description: A bounded outcome records protocol generation repair without raw logs.

evidence.text: Generated protocol stubs contained removed messages; regenerating from the current descriptor removed them. The generator log was stored only by digest.
The protocol compatibility test passed after regeneration.
